definitions.explanation: The front part of the head, containing the eyes, nose, and mouth.

examples.japanese: {顔|かお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}いました→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顔|かお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧{顔|かお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.notes: 顔をする = to have an expression

examples.english: In the morning, when I looked at my face in the mirror, I was surprised to see my eyes were red, so I decided to go to the hospital right away.

notes:
{顔|かお} refers to the face, and is used for both the physical face and facial expressions. Also used figuratively in many idioms.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {顔|かお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧: to wash one's face
- {顔|かお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to show up, make an appearance
- {顔|かお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧: well-connected (lit. wide face)
- {顔|かお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to save face, show respect
- {顔|かお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きく→効く：01932_kiku⟧: to have influence

FACIAL EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧{顔|かお}: happy face
- ⟦{悲|かな}しい→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧{顔|かお}: sad face
- ⟦{怒|おこ}った→怒る：00876_okoru⟧{顔|かお}: angry face
- {顔|かお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a face, have an expression
